items.text:
अथातो द्रव्यशुद्धिस्तु पराशरवचो यथा ।
दारवाणां पात्राणां तक्षणाच्छुद्धिरिष्यते ॥ ७.१ ॥
items.tr:
athāto dravyaśuddhistu parāśaravaco yathā |
dāravāṇāṃ pātrāṇāṃ takṣaṇācchuddhiriṣyate || 7.1 ||
items.en: Now comes the purification of things, as Parāśara stated. Wooden vessels are purified by planing them.

items.text:
भस्मना शुध्यते कांस्यं ताम्रमम्लेन शुध्यति ।
रजसा शुध्यते नारी विकलं या न गच्छति ॥ ७.२ ॥
items.tr:
bhasmanā śudhyate kāṃsyaṃ tāmramamlena śudhyati |
rajasā śudhyate nārī vikalaṃ yā na gacchati || 7.2 ||
items.en: Bronze is purified by ash and copper by something sour. A woman is purified by her menstruation, if she has not gone astray.
items.note: 'vikalaṃ yā na gacchati' is unclear; read as 'who has not gone wrong' (has not been unfaithful or conceived by another man).

items.text:
नदी वेगेन शुध्येत लोपो यदि न दृश्यते ।
वापीकूपतडागेषु दूषितेषु कथंचन ॥ ७.३ ॥
items.tr:
nadī vegena śudhyeta lopo yadi na dṛśyate |
vāpīkūpataḍāgeṣu dūṣiteṣu kathaṃcana || 7.3 ||
items.en: A river is purified by its current, as long as no impurity is still visible. If wells, step-wells or ponds are polluted in any way,

items.text:
उद्धृत्य वै घटशतं पञ्चगव्येन शुध्यति ।
अष्टवर्षा भवेद्गौरी नववर्षा तु रोहिणी ॥ ७.४ ॥
items.tr:
uddhṛtya vai ghaṭaśataṃ pañcagavyena śudhyati |
aṣṭavarṣā bhavedgaurī navavarṣā tu rohiṇī || 7.4 ||
items.en: … they are purified by drawing out a hundred pots of water and adding pañcagavya. A girl of eight years is called Gaurī, and of nine Rohiṇī.

items.text:
दशवर्षा भवेत्कन्या अत ऊर्ध्वं रजस्वला ।
प्राप्ते तु द्वादशे वर्षे यः कन्यां न प्रयच्छति ॥ ७.५ ॥
items.tr:
daśavarṣā bhavetkanyā ata ūrdhvaṃ rajasvalā |
prāpte tu dvādaśe varṣe yaḥ kanyāṃ na prayacchati || 7.5 ||
items.en: A girl of ten is called Kanyā; after that she is menstruating. When the twelfth year arrives, if someone does not give the girl in marriage,

items.text:
मासि मासि रजस्तस्याः पिबन्ति पितरः स्वयम् ।
माता चैव पिता चैव ज्येष्ठो भ्राता तथैव च ॥ ७.६ ॥
items.tr:
māsi māsi rajastasyāḥ pibanti pitaraḥ svayam |
mātā caiva pitā caiva jyeṣṭho bhrātā tathaiva ca || 7.6 ||
items.en: … his ancestors themselves drink her menstrual blood every month. The mother, the father and the eldest brother,

items.text:
त्रयस्ते नरकं यान्ति दृष्ट्वा कन्यां रजस्वलाम् ।
यस्तां समुद्वहेत्कन्यां ब्राह्मणो मदमोहितः ॥ ७.७ ॥
items.tr:
trayaste narakaṃ yānti dṛṣṭvā kanyāṃ rajasvalām |
yastāṃ samudvahetkanyāṃ brāhmaṇo madamohitaḥ || 7.7 ||
items.en: … these three go to hell when they see the girl menstruating while unmarried. A Brahmin who, blinded by passion, marries such a girl

items.text:
असंभाष्यो ह्यपाङ्क्तेयः स विप्रो वृषलीपतिः ।
यः करोत्येकरात्रेण वृषलीसेवनं द्विजः ॥ ७.८ ॥
items.tr:
asaṃbhāṣyo hyapāṅkteyaḥ sa vipro vṛṣalīpatiḥ |
yaḥ karotyekarātreṇa vṛṣalīsevanaṃ dvijaḥ || 7.8 ||
items.en: … is not to be spoken to, is not allowed to sit in the same row at meals, and is called the husband of a vṛṣalī. A twice-born man who has sex with a vṛṣalī even for one night
items.note: vṛṣalī: here a girl who menstruated before marriage; elsewhere it means a Śūdra woman.

items.text:
स भैक्षभुज्जपन्नित्यं त्रिभिर्वर्षैर्विशुध्यति ।
अस्तंगते यदा सूर्ये चण्डालं पतितं स्त्रियम् ॥ ७.९ ॥
items.tr:
sa bhaikṣabhujjapannityaṃ tribhirvarṣairviśudhyati |
astaṃgate yadā sūrye caṇḍālaṃ patitaṃ striyam || 7.9 ||
items.en: … becomes pure in three years, living on alms and reciting prayers every day. After sunset, if one touches a Caṇḍāla, an outcaste, or a woman

items.text:
सूतिकां स्पृशतश्चैव कथं शुद्धिर्विधीयते ।
जातवेदः सुवर्णं च सोममार्गं विलोक्य च ॥ ७.१० ॥
items.tr:
sūtikāṃ spṛśataścaiva kathaṃ śuddhirvidhīyate |
jātavedaḥ suvarṇaṃ ca somamārgaṃ vilokya ca || 7.10 ||
items.en: … who has just given birth, how is purification prescribed? One should look at fire, at gold and at the path of the moon,
items.note: sūtikā: a woman in the impurity period after childbirth.

items.text:
ब्राह्मणानुमतश्चैव स्नानं कृत्वा विशुध्यति ।
स्पृष्ट्वा रजस्वलान्योन्यं ब्राह्मणी ब्राह्मणी तथा ॥ ७.११ ॥
items.tr:
brāhmaṇānumataścaiva snānaṃ kṛtvā viśudhyati |
spṛṣṭvā rajasvalānyonyaṃ brāhmaṇī brāhmaṇī tathā || 7.11 ||
items.en: … and with the Brahmins' permission, bathe, and then one becomes pure. If two menstruating Brahmin women touch each other,

items.text:
तावत्तिष्ठेन्निराहारा त्रिरात्रेणैव शुध्यति ।
स्पृष्ट्वा रजस्वलान्योन्यं ब्राह्मणी क्षत्रिया तथा ॥ ७.१२ ॥
items.tr:
tāvattiṣṭhennirāhārā trirātreṇaiva śudhyati |
spṛṣṭvā rajasvalānyonyaṃ brāhmaṇī kṣatriyā tathā || 7.12 ||
items.en: … each should stay without food for that time (until her period ends) and is purified after three nights. If a menstruating Brahmin woman and a Kṣatriya woman touch each other,

items.text:
अर्धकृच्छ्रं चरेत्पूर्वा पादं एकं अनन्तरा ।
स्पृष्ट्वा रजस्वलान्योन्यं ब्राह्मणी वैश्यजा तथा ॥ ७.१३ ॥
items.tr:
ardhakṛcchraṃ caretpūrvā pādaṃ ekaṃ anantarā |
spṛṣṭvā rajasvalānyonyaṃ brāhmaṇī vaiśyajā tathā || 7.13 ||
items.en: … the first should perform half a Kṛcchra and the second a quarter. If a menstruating Brahmin woman and a Vaiśya woman touch each other,

items.text:
पादहीनं चरेत्पूर्वा पादं एकं अनन्तरा ।
स्पृष्ट्वा रजस्वलान्योन्यं ब्राह्मणी शूद्रजा तथा ॥ ७.१४ ॥
items.tr:
pādahīnaṃ caretpūrvā pādaṃ ekaṃ anantarā |
spṛṣṭvā rajasvalānyonyaṃ brāhmaṇī śūdrajā tathā || 7.14 ||
items.en: … the first should perform three quarters of a Kṛcchra and the second a quarter. If a menstruating Brahmin woman and a Śūdra woman touch each other,

items.text:
कृच्छ्रेण शुध्यते पूर्वा शूद्रा दानेन शुध्यति ।
स्नाता रजस्वला या तु चतुर्थेऽहनि शुध्यति ॥ ७.१५ ॥
items.tr:
kṛcchreṇa śudhyate pūrvā śūdrā dānena śudhyati |
snātā rajasvalā yā tu caturthe'hani śudhyati || 7.15 ||
items.en: … the first is purified by a Kṛcchra and the Śūdra woman by giving a gift. A menstruating woman becomes pure on the fourth day after bathing.

items.text:
कुर्याद्रजो निवृत्तौ तु दैवपित्र्यादि कर्म च ।
रोगेण यद्रजः स्त्रीणां अन्वहं तु प्रवर्तते ॥ ७.१६ ॥
items.tr:
kuryādrajo nivṛttau tu daivapitryādi karma ca |
rogeṇa yadrajaḥ strīṇāṃ anvahaṃ tu pravartate || 7.16 ||
items.en: After the bleeding stops, she may do rites for the gods and the ancestors. If a woman bleeds every day because of illness,

items.text:
नाशुचिः सा ततस्तेन तत्स्याद्वैकालिकं मतम् ।
साध्वाचारा न तावत्स्याद्रजो यावत्प्रवर्तते ॥ ७.१७ ॥
items.tr:
nāśuciḥ sā tatastena tatsyādvaikālikaṃ matam |
sādhvācārā na tāvatsyādrajo yāvatpravartate || 7.17 ||
items.en: … she is not made impure by it, because that bleeding is considered untimely. A woman of good conduct does not take part in normal duties while her period is flowing.
items.note: The second line is unclear; read as 'she keeps apart from normal duties while the regular flow lasts'.

items.text:
रजोनिवृत्तौ गम्या स्त्री गृहकर्मणि चैव हि ।
प्रथमेऽहनि चण्डाली द्वितीये ब्रह्मघातिनी ॥ ७.१८ ॥
items.tr:
rajonivṛttau gamyā strī gṛhakarmaṇi caiva hi |
prathame'hani caṇḍālī dvitīye brahmaghātinī || 7.18 ||
items.en: Once the period is over, the woman may be approached by her husband and may do household work. On the first day she is like a Caṇḍāla woman, on the second like a Brahmin-killer,

items.text:
तृतीये रजकी प्रोक्ता चतुर्थेऽहनि शुध्यति ।
आतुरे स्नानोत्पन्ने दशकृत्वो ह्यनातुरः ॥ ७.१९ ॥
items.tr:
tṛtīye rajakī proktā caturthe'hani śudhyati |
āture snānotpanne daśakṛtvo hyanāturaḥ || 7.19 ||
items.en: … on the third like a washerwoman; on the fourth day she is pure. If a sick person needs a purifying bath, a healthy person should bathe ten times,

items.text:
स्नात्वा स्नात्वा स्पृशेदेनं ततः शुध्येत्स आतुरः ।
उच्छिष्टोच्छिष्टसंस्पृष्टः शुना शूद्रेण वा द्विजः ॥ ७.२० ॥
items.tr:
snātvā snātvā spṛśedenaṃ tataḥ śudhyetsa āturaḥ |
ucchiṣṭocchiṣṭasaṃspṛṣṭaḥ śunā śūdreṇa vā dvijaḥ || 7.20 ||
items.en: … touching the sick person after each bath; then the sick person becomes pure. If a twice-born man who is impure from eating is touched by a dog, or by a Śūdra who is impure from eating,
items.note: ucchiṣṭa: the impure state of someone who has eaten and not yet washed mouth and hands.

items.text:
उपोष्य रजनीं एकां पञ्चगव्येन शुध्यति ।
अनुच्छिष्टेन शूद्रेण स्पर्शे स्नानं विधीयते ॥ ७.२१ ॥
items.tr:
upoṣya rajanīṃ ekāṃ pañcagavyena śudhyati |
anucchiṣṭena śūdreṇa sparśe snānaṃ vidhīyate || 7.21 ||
items.en: … he becomes pure by fasting for one night and taking pañcagavya. If he is touched by a Śūdra who is not impure from eating, a bath is prescribed.

items.text:
तेनोच्छिष्टेन संस्पृष्टः प्राजापत्यं समाचरेत् ।
भस्मना शुध्यते कांस्यं सुरया यन्न लिप्यते ॥ ७.२२ ॥
items.tr:
tenocchiṣṭena saṃspṛṣṭaḥ prājāpatyaṃ samācaret |
bhasmanā śudhyate kāṃsyaṃ surayā yanna lipyate || 7.22 ||
items.en: If that Śūdra was impure from eating, he should perform the Prājāpatya. A bronze vessel is purified by ash, if it has not been smeared with liquor.

items.text:
सुरामात्रेण संस्पृष्टं शुध्यतेऽग्न्युपलेखनैः ।
गवाघ्रातानि कांस्यानि श्वकाकोपहतानि च ॥ ७.२३ ॥
items.tr:
surāmātreṇa saṃspṛṣṭaṃ śudhyate'gnyupalekhanaiḥ |
gavāghrātāni kāṃsyāni śvakākopahatāni ca || 7.23 ||
items.en: If it was touched only by liquor, it is purified by fire and scraping. Bronze vessels sniffed by cows, or spoiled by dogs and crows,

items.text:
शुध्यन्ति दशभिः क्षारैः शूद्रोच्छिष्टानि यानि च ।
गण्डूषं पादशौचं च कृत्वा वै कांस्यभाजने ॥ ७.२४ ॥
items.tr:
śudhyanti daśabhiḥ kṣāraiḥ śūdrocchiṣṭāni yāni ca |
gaṇḍūṣaṃ pādaśaucaṃ ca kṛtvā vai kāṃsyabhājane || 7.24 ||
items.en: … are purified by scrubbing ten times with alkali, and so are those that held a Śūdra's leftovers. If one rinses one's mouth or washes one's feet in a bronze vessel,

items.text:
षण्मासान्भुवि निःक्षिप्य उद्धृत्य पुनराहरेत् ।
आयसेष्वायसानां च सीसस्याग्नौ विशोधनं ॥ ७.२५ ॥
items.tr:
ṣaṇmāsānbhuvi niḥkṣipya uddhṛtya punarāharet |
āyaseṣvāyasānāṃ ca sīsasyāgnau viśodhanaṃ || 7.25 ||
items.en: … one should bury it in the ground for six months, then dig it up and use it again. Iron things are cleaned with iron, and lead is cleaned in fire.
items.note: 'āyaseṣv āyasānāṃ' is unclear; read as iron things being scoured with iron.

items.text:
दन्तं अस्थि तथा भृङ्गं रूप्यं सौवर्णभाजनम् ।
मणिपाषाणपात्राणीत्येतान्प्रक्षालयेज्जलैः ॥ ७.२६ ॥
items.tr:
dantaṃ asthi tathā bhṛṅgaṃ rūpyaṃ sauvarṇabhājanam |
maṇipāṣāṇapātrāṇītyetānprakṣālayejjalaiḥ || 7.26 ||
items.en: Ivory, bone, horn, silver and gold vessels, and vessels of gems and stone: these should be washed with water.

items.text:
पाषाणे तु पुनर्घर्षः शुद्धिरेवं उदाहृता ।
मृण्मये दहनाच्छुद्धिर्धान्यानां मार्जनादपि ॥ ७.२७ ॥
items.tr:
pāṣāṇe tu punargharṣaḥ śuddhirevaṃ udāhṛtā |
mṛṇmaye dahanācchuddhirdhānyānāṃ mārjanādapi || 7.27 ||
items.en: For stone, rubbing it again is the stated purification. Clay pots are purified by firing, and grain by sweeping and cleaning.

items.text:
वेणुवल्कलचीराणां क्षौमकार्पासवाससाम् ।
और्णनेत्रपटानां च प्रोक्षणाच्छुद्धिरिष्यते ॥ ७.२८ ॥
items.tr:
veṇuvalkalacīrāṇāṃ kṣaumakārpāsavāsasām |
aurṇanetrapaṭānāṃ ca prokṣaṇācchuddhiriṣyate || 7.28 ||
items.en: Things of bamboo, bark and rags, linen and cotton clothes, wool and fine cloth are purified by sprinkling water on them.

items.text:
मुञ्जोपस्करशूर्पाणां शणस्य फलचर्मणाम् ।
तृणकाष्ठस्य रज्जूणां उदकाभ्युक्षणं मतं ॥ ७.२९ ॥
items.tr:
muñjopaskaraśūrpāṇāṃ śaṇasya phalacarmaṇām |
tṛṇakāṣṭhasya rajjūṇāṃ udakābhyukṣaṇaṃ mataṃ || 7.29 ||
items.en: For things made of muñja grass, household goods, winnowing baskets, hemp, fruit shells and hides, grass, wood and ropes, sprinkling with water is the rule.
items.note: muñja: a tough grass used for ropes and mats.

items.text:
तूलिकाद्युपधानानि रक्तवस्त्रादिकानि च ।
शोषयित्वातपेनैव प्रोक्षणाच्छुद्धितां इयुः ॥ ७.३० ॥
items.tr:
tūlikādyupadhānāni raktavastrādikāni ca |
śoṣayitvātapenaiva prokṣaṇācchuddhitāṃ iyuḥ || 7.30 ||
items.en: Quilts, pillows and the like, and red cloths and the like, become pure when dried in the sun and sprinkled with water.

items.text:
मार्जारमक्षिकाकीट पतङ्गकृमिदर्दुराः ।
मेध्यामेध्यं स्पृशन्तोऽपि नोच्छिष्टं मनुरब्रवीत् ॥ ७.३१ ॥
items.tr:
mārjāramakṣikākīṭa pataṅgakṛmidardurāḥ |
medhyāmedhyaṃ spṛśanto'pi nocchiṣṭaṃ manurabravīt || 7.31 ||
items.en: Cats, flies, insects, moths, worms and frogs do not make things impure, even when they touch both clean and unclean things. So said Manu.

items.text:
महीं स्पृष्ट्वागतं तोयं याश्चाप्यन्योन्यविप्रुषः ।
भुक्तोच्छिष्टं तथा स्नेहं नोच्छिष्टं मनुरब्रवीत् ॥ ७.३२ ॥
items.tr:
mahīṃ spṛṣṭvāgataṃ toyaṃ yāścāpyanyonyavipruṣaḥ |
bhuktocchiṣṭaṃ tathā snehaṃ nocchiṣṭaṃ manurabravīt || 7.32 ||
items.en: Water that has touched the ground and come back, splashes of drops from one another, and grease left after eating: Manu said these are not impure.

items.text:
ताम्बूलेक्षुफले चैव भुक्तस्नेहानुलेपने ।
मधुपर्के च सोमे च नोच्छिष्टं धर्मतो विदुः ॥ ७.३३ ॥
items.tr:
tāmbūlekṣuphale caiva bhuktasnehānulepane |
madhuparke ca some ca nocchiṣṭaṃ dharmato viduḥ || 7.33 ||
items.en: Betel, sugarcane and fruit, oil or paste applied after eating, madhuparka and soma: those who know dharma do not consider these as leftovers.
items.note: madhuparka: a honey mixture offered to an honoured guest. soma: the sacred drink of Vedic sacrifice.

items.text:
रथ्याकर्दमतोयानि नावः पन्थास्तृणानि च ।
मारुतार्केण शुध्यन्ति पक्वेष्टकचितानि च ॥ ७.३४ ॥
items.tr:
rathyākardamatoyāni nāvaḥ panthāstṛṇāni ca |
mārutārkeṇa śudhyanti pakveṣṭakacitāni ca || 7.34 ||
items.en: Mud and water on the street, boats, paths and grass are purified by wind and sun, and so are buildings of baked brick.

items.text:
अदुष्टा संतता धारा वातोद्धूताश्च रेणवः ।
स्त्रियो वृद्धाश्च बालाश्च न दुष्यन्ति कदाचन ॥ ७.३५ ॥
items.tr:
aduṣṭā saṃtatā dhārā vātoddhūtāśca reṇavaḥ |
striyo vṛddhāśca bālāśca na duṣyanti kadācana || 7.35 ||
items.en: A continuous stream of water, dust blown by the wind, women, old people and children are never impure.

items.text:
देशभङ्गे प्रवासे वा व्याधिषु व्यसनेष्वपि ।
रक्षेदेव स्वदेहादि पश्चाद्धर्मं समाचरेत् ॥ ७.३६ ॥
items.tr:
deśabhaṅge pravāse vā vyādhiṣu vyasaneṣvapi |
rakṣedeva svadehādi paścāddharmaṃ samācaret || 7.36 ||
items.en: When the country is in ruin, when travelling, in illness or in disaster, one should first protect one's own body and life, and only then follow dharma.

items.text:
येन केन च धर्मेण मृदुना दारुणेन वा ।
उद्धरेद्दीनं आत्मानं समर्थो धर्मं आचरेत् ॥ ७.३७ ॥
items.tr:
yena kena ca dharmeṇa mṛdunā dāruṇena vā |
uddhareddīnaṃ ātmānaṃ samartho dharmaṃ ācaret || 7.37 ||
items.en: By any means, gentle or harsh, one should first rescue oneself from distress; when able again, one should follow dharma.

items.text:
आपत्काले तु निस्तीर्णे शौचाचारं तु चिन्तयेत् ।
शुद्धिं समुद्धरेत्पश्चात्स्वस्थो धर्मं समाचरेत् ॥ ७.३८ ॥
items.tr:
āpatkāle tu nistīrṇe śaucācāraṃ tu cintayet |
śuddhiṃ samuddharetpaścātsvastho dharmaṃ samācaret || 7.38 ||
items.en: When the time of emergency is over, one should think again about purity and right conduct. Then one should do the purification, and once well, follow dharma.
